messages:
olivia: Hey team, after upgrading our Node app to the TS/Node SDK v0.26.0 we're suddenly getting 400s from Redwood on /v1/generate. Rolling back to v0.25.3 fixes it. Looks like the SDK is sending a top-level key `requestOptions` instead of `options` in the JSON body — API rejects it. Anyone seen this?

support_agent_jay: Sorry you're hitting this — can you share the exact SDK version, a request_id/trace from the 400, and a minimal repro? In the meantime pinning to 0.25.3 is the safe workaround. :+1:

olivia: version: 0.26.0. Trace id from response: tr-987654321. Here's a redacted request log from our app and the 400 body we get back:

```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rw-neo-1",
  "requestOptions": { "max_tokens": 64, "temperature": 0.7 }
}

auth: Bearer xxxxx

--- response ---
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
{
  "error": "unknown field \"requestOptions\""
}
```

support_agent_jay: Thanks — pushing this up to eng. Can you also paste a tiny code snippet showing how you call the SDK? If you can, a curl that reproduces it would help us triage faster. For the short term you can: 1) pin to 0.25.3, or 2) rewrite the outgoing JSON on a proxy to rename `requestOptions` -> `options`.

devon: I looked at the publish notes for 0.26.0 — there was an internal refactor that wrapped request payloads in a small helper object. That helper should have been compiled away, but it looks like mangled field names slipped into the published bundle. If we can get a minimal repro we can confirm quickly.

olivia: Minimal repro (serverless insert):

```ts
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });

// this used to work in 0.25.x
await client.generate({ model: 'rw-neo-1', requestOptions: { max_tokens: 10 } });
```

Response: 400 unknown field "requestOptions".

eng-ml-sara: Confirmed root cause: a build-time rename transform ran during bundling and the distribution for 0.26.0 accidentally exported the new wrapped field name `requestOptions` instead of the stable `options` field the API expects. We've reproduced it locally with your repro. A fix is in PR #654 (hotfix) — we will publish 0.26.1 with the corrected field shape. ETA ~2 hours.

eng-ml-sara: Short-term mitigation options: (A) pin to 0.25.3, (B) call the HTTP endpoint directly with the proper body: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"rw-neo-1","options":{"max_tokens":10}}'`, or (C) use a tiny middleware to rename `requestOptions` -> `options` before sending.

olivia: Thanks — pinning for now. Can you link the ticket so I can follow? Also please post when 0.26.1 is published and if there are any migration notes. :pray:

deploy-bot: Created support ticket INC-2026 and linked PR #654. Notifying release engineering.

support_agent_jay: Following up — hotfix 0.26.1 has been published and contains the field-shape fix. Please upgrade when you can, or continue to pin to 0.25.3 until you validate. I will keep this thread open until you confirm it's resolved in your environment. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

olivia: Upgraded to 0.26.1 in staging — tests pass and production smoke looks good. No more 400s. Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround. :tada:
